modalLead: A bookmark that points at a video now says so — a small ▶ on the row — and plays where it is. Hovering shows the thumbnail with a play button, and nothing reaches YouTube or Vimeo until you press it.

items.text: A play mark on the row. Any link that is a video — YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion, or a file ending in .mp4 — carries a small ▶, read from the address itself. A channel or a search does not.
Play it on the card. The preview card opens on the thumbnail with a play button over it. Nothing is fetched from the provider until you press it, and the card stays put while the video runs.
From the keyboard. Shift+V puts the cursor on the play button and Enter starts it. Esc, the ✕ over the player or a click away stops it.

The video player and the byline can be kept. Both rows were quietly stripped out of the preview checklist on every save, so ticking them did nothing. They stay now, and a checklist saved in the meantime gets them back.
The keyboard cursor's glow is no longer cut off at the end of a bookmark row.
The paste dialog uses nextDash's own marks for Add bookmark and Save to Inbox instead of emoji from the system font.
